page_note: 本页为IEA《Renewables 2025》第43页，正文讨论拉美与加勒比可再生能源前景，中部为一幅2010-2030年按技术分的净新增装机分组柱状图。

heading.title: Net renewable capacity additions by technology in Latin America and the Caribbean, 2010-2030

components.evidence: five thin bars sit side by side in each year slot from 2010 to 2030
row `Hydropower  Bioenergy  Wind  Solar PV  Other renewables` under the category axis
`Net additions (GW)` set vertically along the left value axis
axis ticks are bare `0, 5, 10 ... 25`; GW only appears in `Net additions (GW)`
horizontal rules at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 across the panel; no vertical rules
21 year slots x 5 technologies = 105 drawn bars

new_components.name: rights_credit_line_below_figure
new_components.evidence: `IEA. CC BY 4.0.` printed small at the lower right under the plot, no `Source:` line
new_components.why_it_matters: 该行是版权署名而非数据来源，解析时容易被当作source行，导致图下唯一小字被误当作数据出处，实际图上没有任何来源或数据链接可辅助定位数值。

new_components.name: figure_frame_rules
new_components.evidence: thin horizontal rules above the title and below the credit line box the whole figure
new_components.why_it_matters: 图形块由上下两条横线界定而非编号，解析器需靠这两条线判断图与正文的边界，否则表格可能吞并周围正文。

new_components.name: unnumbered_figure
new_components.evidence: heading starts directly with `Net renewable capacity additions by technology...`, no `Figure n`
new_components.why_it_matters: 缺少图号时，只能用加粗标题行作为该表的唯一上下文键，若解析输出丢掉标题，数值就无法归属到任何图。

spot_checks.mark: the 2016 Hydropower bar, the tallest light-blue bar reaching the 10 gridline
the 2024 Solar PV bar, the tallest red bar in the figure
the 2021 Solar PV bar, just above the 10 gridline
the 2023 Wind bar, the tallest green bar of the forecast years
the 2025 Wind bar, near the 4.5 level between the 0 and 5 gridlines; the 2027 Wind bar is close in height
the 2030 Solar PV bar, the last red bar; 2028 Solar PV (~17.3) is the nearest competitor

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，唯一刻度是0/5/10/15/20/25，网格间距5 GW对应约55像素，即1 GW≈11像素。要落在5%容差内，4.5这个风电柱只允许±0.23 GW≈2.5像素误差，6.5允许±0.33 GW，而柱宽本身只有约4像素、且五个系列紧挨，柱顶抗锯齿就能吞掉这点差距；20以上的红柱容差稍宽（23.8允许±1.19 GW≈13像素）尚可读。相比之下标签只需“年份+技术”两个键，图例与年度刻度都完整印出，寻址不是瓶颈。
